findings.current: I escaped by a paper-thin margin.
findings.defect: The source says there was only a paper-thin difference before the sticky fog grazed the fingertip; it does not say the narrator escaped. “Escaped” falsely implies he successfully evaded the attack, although he was still touched and cursed.
findings.rationale: The following sentence establishes that the fog did make contact with his little finger, so the source describes an extremely narrow margin rather than a completed escape.
findings.replacement: The difference was no more than a single sheet of paper.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with one minor overstatement of the near miss before the curse takes effect.
